text: Her sister called her a jinx. The crime lord who raised her called her perfect.
Piltover is a shining city of inventors. Beneath it lies Zaun, the undercity: poor, poisoned and lawless.
Down there, glowing crystals called hextech can power anything, or blow it apart.
Powder and her big sister, Vi, were orphans, raised by Vander, a retired fighter.
Her brother Mylo called her a jinx: someone who ruins everything she touches. Only Vi believed in her.
Powder built little bombs shaped like monkeys. None of them ever worked.
Then a crime boss, Silco, captured Vander. The kids went to save him, and left Powder behind.
She followed them with a monkey bomb, packed with hextech crystals. This time, it worked.
The blast killed two of her brothers. Vander was lost.
And Vi said it. Mylo was right. You're a jinx. Then Vi was gone.
Alone in the smoke, she ran into the arms of the man who started it all. Silco took her in.
He raised her as his daughter. Powder became Jinx: brilliant, broken, and dangerous.
Years later, in a breakdown, she shot him. Then she fired a rocket at the council of Piltover.
That explains her pain. It doesn't excuse what she did.
With his last breath, Silco said he never would have given her up. Don't cry. You're perfect.
Her sister called her a jinx. A monster called her perfect.
